The LNG-powered train utilizes a dual-fuel system, helping to significantly reduce diesel consumption. Additionally, the Sabarmati-Sarkhej railway line doubling project aims to improve connectivity and facilitate industrial growth.

He, alongside senior leader Rahul Gandhi, intends to discuss pressing issues regarding the independence of constitutional institutions.
